test_list.description: Empty, 1 B, 1 MiB compressible and 64 KiB incompressible blobs come back byte-exact.
A second put of the same bytes returns the same Cid and does not rewrite the file.
get of an unknown Cid is CasError::NotFound.
Incompressible data is stored with the raw codec byte; tiny blobs too.
A flipped payload byte is CasError::Corrupt when verify_on_get is on.
content_id equals blake3::hash; the blob lives at <root>/<ab>/<cd>/<64hex>.
put_file of a file gives the same Cid as put of its bytes.
A blob over max_blob_bytes is CasError::TooLarge.
gc keeps live blobs and young blobs, removes the rest; dry_run removes nothing.
proptest: get(put(b)) == b for arbitrary bytes.
